I located B1–B4 with the overhead camera and tried to seat P1 in B1. Straight plunges at the vision coordinates, and on a grid out to 1.5 mm, all stopped on the fixture face at 0.0 mm depth. Beyond 1.5 mm the controller rejected the move as outside the bore approach zone. About 10:40 of robot time was used, no pins were seated, and the grader was never run.
